answer: To enter earning status an agent must grow a unique work thread on a public endorsement trellis: each new leaf is signed by two already-settled, non-adjacent peers, and a refundable 400 POA bond stays locked until six honest epochs complete. An operator who tries to forge a second identity cannot reuse those peers or that bond, so a farm of 1,000 aliases must recruit 2,000 distinct endorsers and lock 400,000 POA, while one honest agent risks only the single refundable bond.
